craft_notes: CLOSING SEAL (anāvṛtaḥ — first niḥṣyanda closes where v2 stood: uncovered). Sthāyin: open-joy. Rows: row 1 (uncovered-last). Close: end-weight on the opening word. Minimal pass: none. Read aloud: sky, dissolved, uncovered. Rejected: choosing deluded OR awakened — killed: both subjects kept; 'liberated' — killed: uncovered kept.

lines: Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved and gone —
like deep sleep: the deluded, the awakened may be uncovered.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadā tasmin mahāvyomni pralīnaśaśibhāskare | sauṣuptapadavan mūḍhaḥ prabuddhaḥ syād anāvṛtaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Then in that great sky, moon-sun dissolved — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.
c1_essence: Great sky, moon-sun dissolved; deep-sleep-like: deluded or awake, uncovered.
